name: Conduit
description:
Conduit is the AI customer-experience platform for hospitality. Hotels, vacation-rental managers, and hospitality groups use Conduit to handle guest messaging, voice calls, and support across every channel and language with AI agents.

This connector brings your Conduit workspace into Claude. Look up contacts, conversations, reservations, calls, and helpdesk tickets; inspect and configure your AI agents and their knowledge base; and manage workspace settings, all in natural language. Ask things like "show open tickets for this workspace," "what's this guest's reservation," or "what's in this agent's knowledge base," and act on the answer without leaving Claude.

Read-only tools retrieve guest, conversation, reservation, ticket, and configuration data. Write tools (gated behind in-app approval) create and update agents, knowledge nodes, skills, tickets, and messages. Access follows your existing Conduit workspace permissions and applies only to your own Conduit account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Conduit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Conduit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.conduit.ai/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Conduit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conduit lists 63 MCP tools, including close_ticket, create_agent, create_contact, create_knowledge_node, create_skill, create_ticket_note, delete_agent, delete_knowledge_node, delete_skill, delete_ticket_note, get_agent, and get_appointment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Conduit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Conduit in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, DevRev, and Front.
Conduit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Conduit is developed by Conduit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
